musique.description:
Global Metadata: Cinematic electronic with folk textures (Quebec winter), 110 BPM, EN: warm analog synth pads, felt piano, low sub pulse, hand percussion and a distant stomp-clap, frosty high string harmonics, building from intimate dawn to a wide emotional uplift; mix wide and warm, bass gentle, no vocals, no brass stabs. Loud polished master.

Vocal Details: Instrumental, no lyrics, no vocals, no choir.

Arrangement: [Dawn intro] at 0 seconds: EN: felt piano and cold wind texture, sub pulse enters at 2.5s, intimate [First build] at 5 seconds: EN: hand percussion and synth arpeggio join, momentum rising [Approval drop] at 13 seconds: EN: beat drops on the thumb press, warm bass and clap enter, confident [Chantier lift] at 22 seconds: EN: full groove, string harmonics soaring, wide stereo, uplifting [Briefing peak] at 30 seconds: EN: peak energy, layered percussion, piano motif returns [Emotional resolve] at 36 seconds: EN: strip back to piano and pads, warm sunrise chord, then soft tail Strong hits at 3.0, 13.0, 16.0, 22.0, 29.0, 36.0 seconds. Clean ending at 48 seconds.
